excerpt: Bollimunta et al. recorded differential voltages across the approximately 2 mm cortical mantle with a 14-electrode linear array in alert monkeys. In areas V2 and V4, infragranular layers served as local alpha pacemakers with small granular influence; alpha power in V2 and V4 showed strong negative correlations with task performance.
overview: The monkey laminar evidence supplies anatomical depth missing from scalp EEG. Local pacemaker patterns and performance correlations in V2/V4 are consistent with cortico-cortical feedback and suppression of competing visual information. The review also notes that IT showed a different positive correlation, so alpha is not treated as a unitary rhythm across cortical areas.
title: Monkey Laminar Alpha
